description: A UPC-12 sold in one country and an EAN-13 sold in another identify the
same product. The canonical form is the code zero-padded to 14 digits, and
that is what retailer_products.gtin14 and marketplace_products.gtins store.
These fixtures define the expected mapping. The normalisation function that
produces it is T18 (src/services/matching/gtin.ts) and is deliberately not
implemented here — this file is the contract it will be tested against.

products.label: same product listed as UPC-12 in one market and EAN-13 in another
